svg.aria-label: 2D Iso-Effective-Cost Phase Space and $60/hour Human Waiting Cost Stack across 23 passing models
svg.text: Layer 4 · Total Effective Cost = AI Credits ($0.01/cr) + Engineer Waiting Time ($60/hr)
The Human Waiting-Time Equation: Why a $0.04 Model Can Cost $7.99 in Engineer Time
Left: Compute cost ($) vs. wall-clock time (s) with $60/h iso-cost curves (√-scaled axes). Right: Total effective cost stack at k=1 ($60/h).
Dot Center = Strict Pass (9/23) · Open Circle = Spec-Fair Pass (14/23)
4-Task Compute Cost in AI Credits ($ USD, √-scale) →
At $60/h (k=1), claude-sonnet-5.5 ($0.53 credits + $1.86 time = $2.39) is #1 overall; claude-haiku-5.5 ($0.04 credits + $7.95 time = $7.99) drops to #16 due to 404s on regex.
